what: The SIMPLE marker plan does not cover pre-PR paused SIMPLE sessions with .completed/step-2a present and .completed/step-2a.5 absent
scenario_or_breakage: For state step-2a=present step-2a.5=absent, regardless of step-3b/finalize, pause/resume routes to Step 2a.5. The proposed Step 2a entry SIMPLE guard no longer runs, and the proposed Step 2a.5 prose only says the marker was already written, so .completed/step-2a.5 remains missing and later pauses can route back to Step 2a.5.
suggested_fix: Add a minimal SIMPLE-guarded compatibility write on the Step 2a.5 skip path, or normalize that resume state back to Step 2a. Keep artifact sentinel file writes entry-fence-only and HARD paths untouched.
